stem: What is the most likely reason the author does not tell her friends that her mother is paralyzed?

options.label: A
options.text: She does not want people to judge her mother because of her disability.

options.label: B
options.text: She prefers to let her mother explain her own situation to others.

options.label: C
options.text: She does not think it is an important characteristic of her mother.

options.label: D
options.text: She thinks that most people already know her mother uses a wheelchair.
